app.title: Tremplin: internships and jobs
login.lede: Internships and jobs: search, apply and follow every application, from the first posting to the reply.
login.perk1: Internships and jobs in one place
login.hint: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a number. Avoid common passwords.
login.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
board.empty: Drag a card here or add one.
board.moveError: Couldn't move the card. Try again.
welcome.title: Welcome to Tremplin
welcome.text: Start by searching for internships or jobs, then save the ones you like. You'll be able to follow each one until you get a reply.
search.title: Find an internship or a job
search.lede: Set up your search once, then open it on each site, anywhere in Canada. It opens in a new tab with your job title and location already filled in.
search.noDate: The date filter doesn't apply here.
search.foundText: Save it right away to your applications, with its link and application deadline.
site.jobbank.name: Job Bank
site.jobbank.note: Canada's official job site, with postings in every province. The most complete.
site.indeed.note: A huge number of postings, with a date filter.
site.linkedin.note: Jobs and recruiters. Sign in to apply in one click.
site.linkedin.noteStage: Internship filter on. Handy for spotting recruiters.
site.gc.name: GC Jobs
site.gc.note: Federal public service, across the country. Filter by region on the site.
site.fswep.name: Federal Student Work Experience Program
site.fswep.note: Student jobs and work placements in the federal public service.
site.students.name: Student recruitment
site.students.note: All programs for students and recent graduates.
account.title: Account
account.pwChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.sessionsText: Sign out of every open session on all your devices. Sessions also expire on their own after 30 minutes.
account.dataText: Download everything Tremplin keeps about you (your applications), as JSON or as a spreadsheet for Excel.
account.deleteText: Permanently deletes your account and all your data. This can't be undone.
err.email_taken: This email is already in use.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {min} min.
err.too_many_registrations: Too many sign-ups. Try again later.
err.not_authenticated: Session expired. Please sign in again.
err.password_too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
err.password_too_long: The password is too long (72 bytes maximum).
err.password_needs_letter_digit: The password must contain at least one letter and one number.
err.invalid_characters: This field contains characters that aren't allowed.
err.invalid_url: The link must start with http:// or https://.
err.password_invalid_characters: The password contains a character that isn't allowed.
login.codeHint: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy...).
account.twofaText: Add a one-time code from your phone on top of your password. Even if your password leaks, nobody can get in.
account.twofaScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
account.twofaManual: Or enter this key by hand:
account.recoveryWarn: Keep them somewhere safe (password manager or paper). Each works once, and they will never be shown again.
account.newRecoveryText: The old codes will stop working.
err.invalid_challenge: Verification expired. Please sign in again.
err.password_too_common: That password is too common. Pick a less predictable one.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter your email: if an account exists, we'll send you a link valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a link was just sent. Check your spam folder too.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.code: 6-digit or recovery code (only if two-factor authentication is on)
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
verify.banner: Verify your email so you can recover your account if you forget your password.
err.invalid_token: Invalid or expired link. Request a new one.
